stem: What does the author’s inclusion of the sample signs after paragraph 7 reveal about her?

options.label: A
options.text: She realizes that the cafeteria manager will need instructions on what to serve.

options.label: B
options.text: She wants visitors to the school to know that the Beautification Club sponsors the composting.

options.label: C
options.text: She does not think students at her school will want to participate in composting.

options.label: D
options.text: She understands that guidance will be necessary in order to make composting a success at her school.
